name: Boodles British Gin
production: Carter-Head still / vacuum still (Wikipedia names both) [cần kiểm tra]
history: 1762 | Boodle's gentlemen's club in St James's, London, founded by Edward Boodle – the gin's namesake
1845 | Boodles gin created (originally by Cock Russell & Company)
2000 | Passed to Pernod Ricard with the break-up of Seagram's assets (Difford's; Wikipedia says 2001)
2013 | Released in the UK (October) at 40% with redesigned bottle; previously US and Japan only
notes: Unusually contains no citrus botanicals. Formerly bottled in Fort Smith, Arkansas from concentrate shipped by G&J; now bottled in UK. Tasting notes are Difford's Guide reviewer notes (not producer).
